Available September 2022 · Unfurnished · One Bedroom Apartment

Acorn Properties are delighted to offer for rent this one bedroom unfurnished apartment available now situated on Langley Mere in Forest Hall. The property comprises entrance hallway, lounge, kitchen, bedroom and bathroom. The accommodation is ideally situated for all the shops on Station Road North and Benton Metro station is also a short walk away. To view call Acorn today 0191 212 2020. Please note- stock images of a similar property on the development.
